name: Hue Festival
summary: Festival Huế 2026 runs the whole year. It opened at Ngọ Môn square on 1 January 2026 with the reconstructed Ban Sóc rite, and the arts week is 13–18 June 2026. The year is four seasons of court and folk rites, a mid-autumn lantern programme, and a winter music programme named for Trịnh Công Sơn, then a countdown on 31 December 2026. The conservation centre is the standing office. This is not the ordinary citadel ticket. A visitor fee is check on arrival. Dates after 2026 are check on arrival. The photograph is a 2008 court procession, not that June week.
when: 1 January 2026 through 31 December 2026. Arts week 13–18 June 2026. Later years: check on arrival. Do not copy 13–18 June onto a later year.
